linux.command: HASH=$(git -C ./dep/vcpkg rev-parse HEAD) && if [ -f vcpkg.json ]; then jq --arg hash "$HASH" '."builtin-baseline" = $hash' vcpkg.json > vcpkg.json.tmp && mv vcpkg.json.tmp vcpkg.json; else echo '{"builtin-baseline": "'"$HASH"'"}' > vcpkg.json; fi && cp cmake/x86-linux-sm.cmake dep/vcpkg/triplets/x86-linux-sm.cmake && ./dep/vcpkg/bootstrap-vcpkg.sh -musl && ./dep/vcpkg/vcpkg install --triplet x86-linux-sm --debug && rm -rf build && cmake -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE="./dep/vcpkg/scripts/buildsystems/vcpkg.cmake" -DVCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET=x86-linux-sm -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_INIT="-m32" -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS_INIT="-m32" && cmake --build build -j
